relations.rationale: The gathering event provides context in which a refreshment table opening time could be announced, but does not itself imply it.
The club gathering sets a general context but does not bear on whether Nell offered track spacing suggestions.
The gathering happening in the morning supports the plausibility of later events like visitors arriving in the afternoon of the same event.
Layouts being on tables makes it plausible one of them is the largest, mountain scene layout.
The layouts being on tables is consistent with one being placed near the door, but doesn't specifically support that detail.
The physical arrangement of layouts has no bearing on which class Bo and Nell share.
The layout arrangement is unrelated to Zeno's steam engine restoration effort.
The layout arrangement has no bearing on refreshment table timing.
Having layouts spread across tables supports the later claim that visitors were curious about the miniature world spread across tables.
Hugo being the organizer doesn't imply anything about Nell's suggestions on track spacing.
Finn arriving early with a box directly leads to him placing that box beside the entrance table.
Finn's arrival with rolling stock is unrelated to Bo's separate arrival with scenery pieces.
Finn's early arrival is unrelated to Hugo checking the attendance sheet.
Finn's early arrival supports the idea that most attendees had arrived, consistent with only two latecomers.
Finn arriving with painted rolling stock is consistent with and supports his skill implied by placing second in scratch-building competition.
Finn placing his box near the entrance is unrelated to Zeno bringing a first-aid kit.
Finn's box placement has no bearing on attendance status.
Bo's age relative to Finn is unrelated to Nell's height relative to Bo and Hugo.
Bo being older than Finn doesn't preclude or support them being in the same class.
Bo's age relative to Finn is unrelated to refreshment table timing.
